question: How close are the library pigment colours and Kubelka-Munk constants (scattering by transparency, tinting strength) to real paints? They are estimated, not measured, and mixing is done per RGB channel rather than over the full spectrum.
probes: Settled: mixing runs over the spectrum (spectral Kubelka-Munk, 31 bands 400-700 nm) by default, with RGB as an option, so the 'per RGB channel' part of the question no longer applies (commit 6124450).
Still open: each paint's reflectance curve is rebuilt from one masstone colour (the smoothest curve that matches it), not measured; real pigments can have sharper curves.
Compare recipes with real swatches painted by the artist
Measure masstone and tints of the artist's paints (or enter measured spectra) to replace the estimates
